kc4x2pbw.sourceDescription: A new addition to our range, introducing the stunning Pre-lit Matterhorn Pine, a brand-new and unique style featuring short-cut, 100% realistic pine needle branches and warm white led lights for an incredibly lifelike appearance. krgff43z.baseName: Neo Pre-Lit Snow Flocked Christmas Wreath with Warm White LED Lights
krgff43z.variantName: Neo Pre-Lit Snow Flocked Christmas Wreath with Warm White LED Lights
krgff43z.sourceDescription: Create a beautiful winter-inspired festive display with this Pre-Lit Snow Flocked Christmas Wreath, featuring full artificial pine foliage finished with a decorative snow-flocked effect. The layered branches and varied pine tips provide plenty of depth and texture, creating a full, traditional appearance that makes an eye-catching addition to your Christmas decorations. Integrated warm white LED lights are distributed throughout the foliage, adding a soft seasonal glow that highlights the snowy finish and creates a welcoming atmosphere. The pre-lit design means the lighting is already incorporated into the wreath, making it easy to add an illuminated feature to your festive display. The wreath is ideal for displaying on doors, walls, windows, above fireplaces and other suitable areas around the home. Its combination of classic green pine foliage, snow-flocked detailing and warm white lighting coordinates easily with a wide variety of Christmas decorating themes. Made from artificial foliage, the wreath requires no watering or ongoing maintenance. Once the festive season is over, it can be carefully stored away and brought out again the following Christmas. nc6qw7v3.baseName: Christmas Village Electric Rotating Christmas Tree Stand - White
nc6qw7v3.variantName: Christmas Village Electric Rotating Christmas Tree Stand - White
nc6qw7v3.sourceDescription: Bring your Christmas tree display to life with the Christmas Village Electric Rotating Christmas Tree Stand. Designed for indoor use, the motorised base completes a full 360° rotation every 72 seconds and offers three operating modes: lights with rotation, lights only, or off. The sturdy five-point star base is made from ABS plastic and supports Christmas trees up to 7ft tall and weighing up to 35kg. Three adjustable caps accommodate tree pole diameters of 1.9cm, 2.2cm and 3.2cm. Supplied with a UK plug featuring a 5A fuse and a 1.5m power cord. Product Dimensions: Height (H): 20.5cm, Width (W): 65cm, Depth (D): 65cm. Product Weight: 1.79kg. Colour: White. Includes 1 electric rotating tree stand base and 3 adjustable caps. For indoor use only. Read all instructions before use. Place on a flat, stable surface. Ensure the christmas tree is securely fitted before operating. Suitable for trees up to 7ft tall and 35kg maximum weight. Keep away from water and heat sources. Do not operate with a damaged power cord or plug. Switch off and unplug before adjusting or moving the stand. Keep out of reach of children. HSI Global Ltd - 9 George Square Suite 320 Glasgow, G2 1QQ
